newsitem.title: USA: SNET to test U.S. Robotics x2 modems.
newsitem.headline: SNET to test U.S. Robotics x2 modems.

text.p: U.S. Robotics Corp said Monday SNET will test U.S. Robotics' next-generation computer modem, the x2, in early 1997 in preparation for more general distribution to customers.
SNET, a unit of Southern New England Telecommunications Corp, is an Internet services provider that also offers local, national and international calling.

The x2 modem increases the speed of standard computer data transmission to as much as 56 kilobytes per second from current top speeds ranging from 28.8 kilobytes per second and 33.6 kilobytes per second, U.S. Robotics said in a statement.
SNET plans to offer the x2 to all of its Internet service customers by the end of the first quarter of 1997.
U.S. Robotics makes information access products, including computer modems.
U.S. Robotics stock was down one Monday afternoon at 72.
